sourceTitle: Waymo’s autonomously driven Jaguar I-PACE navigating Los Angeles
use: Waymo official media resources explicitly allow press and educational purposes with attribution.
adaptations: Trimmed, resized to 1280×720, H.264 encoded, audio removed; original shot order and speed retained.
visualReview: Reviewed every second of the selected excerpt: daylight driving shots at intersections, followed by a dusk street shot with headlights. The vehicle and sensor equipment are visible, as are surrounding road users. Desktop and 320-pixel media layouts inspected; the Waymo vehicle is clearly visible in the initial poster. Playback, pause, replay, and timed description loading passed the project checks.
claimBoundary: Official Waymo real-world autonomous driving B-roll, distinct from the paper’s simulation and authors’ research controller.
